parameters.name: AutoAvif
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable adaptive AVIF. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: AutoWebp
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable adaptive WebP. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable image transformation. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version on which the configuration takes effect. The default value is 0.
